name: vision
title_zh: 带时间戳的视频帧联系表，读图就知道录像里发生了什么
tagline_zh: 不用逐帧拖进度条，也不用信别人的转述。录完的素材、崩掉的界面、一闪而过的报错，摊开成图。
tagline_en: Stop scrubbing and trusting hearsay. Turn any recording into a readable grid of timestamped frames — spot the.
desc_en: Look at what a recording actually shows, by tiling its frames into timestamped contact sheets you can read as images. Use when you need to know what happened in a video rather than take someone's word for it — checking a take you just recorded, finding where a layout breaks, locating the moment an error appeared, or answering a question about a video you cannot watch.
why_zh: 它不抽关键帧，而是把整段视频均匀铺成带时间码的格子，像看连环画一样读画面。你找的是「某时刻长什么样」。
why_en: It doesn't pick highlights — it tiles the whole timeline into timestamped frames, so you read what actually happened at any.
limit_zh: 只处理本地视频文件，不接直播流或在线链接；输出是静态拼图，不含音频波形或字幕；超长视频（>2小时）会生成大量图片。
limit_en: Local video files only — no live streams or URLs. Output is static contact sheets, no audio or subtitles. Videos over 2h produce many images; manage.
